When the sign flag is not the sign

The sign flag is a copy of the top bit of the stored result. When the
overflow flag is set that bit is not the sign of the true answer, and
the sign has to be read as SF exclusive or OF.

------  ------  ------  --  --  ---------

-20000  -20000   25536   0   1  negative
   100    -300    -200   1   0  negative
   300    -100     200   0   0  positive

  JL is not taken, because JL asks whether SF and OF differ.

JS and JNS. JS reads one bit and JL reads the pair.
